candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner sets owner = tx.origin instead of provided _owner.
Remove the assignment to owner so setOwner no longer changes owner (no state update).
Assign owner to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the provided _owner.
Insert an extra assignment that sets owner to address(0) after assigning the provided _owner, causing owner to end up as zero address.

Change the onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != owner (reversing the require), which will allow non-owners and block the original owner, altering whether setOwner can execute and thus owner after call.
Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller by removing the require (thus anyone can call setOwner and change owner).
Modify onlyOwner to require tx.origin == owner instead of msg.sender, changing which caller is authorized to call setOwner.
